---
title: "Session 14 · Random generation and simulation"
subtitle: "Design a Monte Carlo experiment before writing the loop"

## Learning goals

Use R's distribution functions, control random-number generation, define a
simulation with the ADEMP framework, estimate Type I error or power, and quantify
Monte Carlo uncertainty.
